core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hasna corresponds to the Arabic form حسنا (Arabic root ح س ن (ḥ-s-n); حُسْنَى (Ḥusnā)). Its core sense is good, beautiful, virtuous, excellent. Hasna is Arabic حُسْنَى (Ḥusnā) 'most beautiful, best', the feminine elative of حَسَن (ḥasan), from the root ح س ن (ḥ-s-n). The source gloss 'Beautiful, Good, Graceful' is broadly consistent. Same name as hasnaa and hasnah.
